name: gizza-ai/cert-chain-validate
summary: Validate a PEM certificate chain offline.

tool.description: Checks a pasted PEM certificate chain offline for leaf-to-root ordering, issuer/subject linkage, certificate signatures, CA flags and current validity windows. It does not consult browser or OS trust stores.

chain_pem.description: Leaf-to-root PEM certificate chain. Paste one or more -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- blocks in order: leaf, intermediates, then optional self-signed root.
